case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

judge.summary: The clip visibly delivers the smiling garden portrait and clean, correctly positioned lower third, with no evident visual problems; silence cannot be verified from still frames.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The frames show a smiling woman turning from a side view toward the camera amid garden plots and plant supports.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: Both lines read exactly as requested, and no other text is visible.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: The white text is clearly readable on a dark translucent rectangle at the bottom left, with comfortable margins and no clipping.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: The lower third stays in the same position in the captioned frames and remains well below her face.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: It is absent at 0.9 seconds and present at 2.7, 4.6, and 6.4 seconds, consistent with the requested timing.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The supplied images are widescreen and the stated duration is 7.3 seconds, but silence cannot be verified from images.
